policy: Primary references only. A source supports a technique or specification, not Helix qualification. Moving URLs must be pinned again before dependency import. Public abstracts/scopes are not full normative or experimental replication evidence.

sources.title: ST STM32H723ZE product specification
sources.basis: ZE specification: 512 KB flash, 564 KB aggregate RAM, up to 550 MHz; peripheral capability reference.
sources.caveat: Actual chip, clock, memory placement and board routing remain audit gates.

sources.title: BTT Octopus Pro official hardware repository
sources.basis: Revision-specific repository and V1.1 schematic file location previously identified.
sources.caveat: Schematic content and fitted CAN transceiver were not successfully inspected; no pin map or CAN FD rate is established by this source record.

sources.title: STM32CubeH7 DMA/cache integration example
sources.basis: Vendor example documentation discusses DMA memory, alignment and cache maintenance.
sources.caveat: H747 example is a pattern reference, not an H723 memory map or a Helix driver implementation; only relevant documentation excerpts were reviewed.

sources.title: Orocos KDL Levenberg-Marquardt IK implementation documentation
sources.basis: Adaptive damping, weighted residuals, cached transforms/Jacobians and construction-time allocation are documented.
sources.caveat: Does not prove convergence for every target, collision freedom or timing on the Octopus.

sources.title: Pinocchio inverse-kinematics example
sources.basis: Reviewed blob 399cb1d538631dd48916eb92a451b10bc7ddec19: pose log residual, Jlog correction and damped LDLT solve.
sources.caveat: Educational desktop example, not a bounded real-time or joint-limit-complete controller; no source code copied.

sources.title: TRACLabs TRAC-IK
sources.basis: Alternative numerical/SQP searches address limitations of local joint-limit handling.
sources.caveat: Host-side comparison candidate; concurrency and variable search work are not selected for the MCU path.

sources.title: Jerk-limited Real-time Trajectory Generation with Arbitrary Target States
sources.basis: RSS 2021 paper by Berscheid and Kroeger describes synchronized third-order state-to-state motion generation and reported tests.
sources.caveat: Paper/author results are not independently replicated here and do not establish H723 worst-case timing.

sources.title: Ruckig current implementation and build options
sources.basis: README blob e3c6cd942f45031c53e0fb5f2bbeae5596f0cfca and CMake blob 9271f7c871c65026bde0b433c94e4ccc1de01553 reviewed. CMake identifies 0.19.6, C++20 and default-enabled cloud client; Community intermediate waypoints use cloud calculation.
sources.caveat: Candidate/oracle only. No dependency imported. Local state-to-state evaluation must exclude cloud features and qualify allocation, licensing, limits and board timing.

sources.title: MoveIt time parameterization documentation
sources.basis: Explains retiming/smoothing and geometric deviation that can require renewed collision checks.
sources.caveat: Method reference only; not adoption of MoveIt as the Helix control stack.

sources.title: Analog Devices TMC2209
sources.basis: Two-phase STEP/DIR stepper driver with UART, interpolation and load/stall diagnostics.
sources.caveat: Fitted module/current/voltage/thermal limits must be verified; diagnostics are not independent output-position feedback or safety certification.

sources.title: moteus brushless servo hardware and firmware
sources.basis: Repository documents local high-rate motor control and CAN FD communication with separate host control.
sources.caveat: Architecture reference/possible adapter only; no moteus hardware selected or compatibility certified.

sources.title: moteus dual encoder guide
sources.basis: Separate motor/output sensing, reducer mapping and absolute-position limitations.
sources.caveat: Helix sensor accuracy, mounting and loop design require independent qualification.

sources.title: ODrive hardware and gearbox configuration
sources.basis: Reviewed documentation identified 0.6.12; covers dual encoders, transmission effects, thermal behavior, regeneration and calibration.
sources.caveat: Experimental vendor features are not treated as proven general solutions; settings/gains must not be copied into Helix without qualification.

sources.title: ODrive CAN protocol
sources.basis: Reviewed documentation identified 0.6.12; CAN FD support is device/version-specific and CANSimple payloads remain at most eight bytes.
sources.caveat: Pin exact selected firmware/protocol at implementation. CANSimple is not automatically CANopen or timestamp-synchronized motion.

sources.title: CiA 402 drive and motion-control profile overview
sources.basis: Drive state/mode concepts and profile mappings provide interoperability vocabulary.
sources.caveat: Overview only; borrowing states or using CAN does not establish full profile compliance.

sources.title: CAN in Automation: CAN FD
sources.basis: Separate arbitration/data phases and payloads up to 64 bytes.
sources.caveat: Actual rate depends on qualified controllers, transceivers and physical network; no stock Octopus rate claimed.

sources.title: EtherCAT Technology Group technology overview
sources.basis: Distributed clocks provide an established industrial synchronization architecture.
sources.caveat: Deferred alternative; does not imply a complete EtherCAT interface on the Octopus or automatic drive interchangeability.

sources.title: OSHA technical manual: industrial robot systems and applications
sources.basis: System-level hazards include controls, peripherals, stored energy and integration failures.
sources.caveat: Engineering reference, not an Australian legal compliance assessment or certification.

sources.title: ISO 10218-1:2025 public scope and edition information
sources.basis: Current robot-safety standards lead with explicit scope and exclusions.
sources.caveat: Full normative text not reviewed; applicability and complete robot/cell obligations need a separate competent review.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-193 platform firmware resiliency guidelines
sources.basis: Protect, detect and recover as firmware-resilience design objectives.
sources.caveat: Not an implementation recipe or certification for this MCU; flash, bootloader and trust model must be established.

sources.title: STM32H7 HAL component compatibility guidance
sources.basis: README blob 22a89573f2e45bb1aee01836bd254f5f3e99aeff requires consistent CMSIS Core, CMSIS Device and HAL versions.
sources.caveat: No dependency set is imported or pinned as an approved firmware build by this specification.

sources.title: Consistent Overhead Byte Stuffing, original author publication
sources.basis: Bounded-overhead serial framing and delimiter-based resynchronization.
sources.caveat: Framing alone provides neither message integrity nor authorization; implementation and resource bounds require testing.

sources.title: RFC 3309: CRC-32C checksum definition
sources.basis: CRC-32C polynomial and checksum-convention reference for a fully specified tested implementation.
sources.caveat: SCTP framing is not adopted. CRC is not cryptographic authentication; our byte order and coverage need explicit vectors.

sources.title: IK-Geo: unified inverse kinematics using subproblem decomposition
sources.basis: 2025 publication and author summary classify 6R geometry into closed-form or low-dimensional search cases.
sources.caveat: Author/research evidence, not a Helix benchmark; geometry eligibility, calibration effects and embedded cost remain untested.

sources.title: Automatic Geometric Decomposition for Analytical Inverse Kinematics
sources.basis: 2025 RA-L work reports automatic geometric classification/decomposition with an open implementation.
sources.caveat: Public institutional abstract reviewed, not a replicated experiment or a blanket real-world performance guarantee.
